## Invitations

A total of 6917 people were invited during the outreach period. Of these, 1865 attended, giving an attendance rate of 27.0 per cent. The figures provide a summary of participation following the distribution of invitations across North City. Attendance was recorded for those who came to the outreach activity, while the invitation total represents the people contacted in advance.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This supported delivery of the outreach programme in areas that could be reached safely and practically. Arrangements were kept under review to support attendance and maintain access during the period covered by this report.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded number of people receiving a reminder was 0. Contact activity therefore relied on the invitation arrangements already in place rather than SMS or reminder messaging.

Prepared by G. Evans.
